description: Full input schema (field names, types, units, options) of one calculator. Optional: search_calculators already returns a compact schema per hit.

lang.description: Optional language for labels, titles and number formatting: en, es, vi, hi, ja, ko, tr, ar, ru, fr, zh, tw, pt, de (zh = Simplified, tw = Traditional Chinese; zh-CN / zh-TW / vi-VN style tags are accepted). Default: en.

name.description: Tool name from search_calculators, e.g. bmi_calculator.

name: get_calculator_schema
